title: stream_logs arguments (server "exec", tool "stream_logs")
description: The arguments of mcp-exec's stream_logs tool (StreamLogsRequest): the output of a command that exec started, from a byte offset, and its status. It starts nothing.

id.description: The execution's UUID, as exec returned it.

offset.description: Byte offset to read from; next_offset of the previous answer, or 0.
